targets.name: Example Static Site
targets.notes: Pure static frontend, so there is no backend to call. Hits PostgREST directly, which reaches Postgres and resets the 7-day pause timer.

targets.name: Example API
targets.notes: Render free service: spins down after 15 minutes idle. The health endpoint runs SELECT 1, so a cached 200 cannot pass for a live database.

targets.name: Example Atlas Cluster
targets.notes: Fallback for a cluster with no deployed app in front of it. Requires 0.0.0.0/0 in the Atlas IP access list - see SETUP.md before enabling.
